verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for spend-management software, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Ramp offers a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of its core platform. Everything documented is Ramp-hosted: the MCP servers at mcp.ramp.com, the API, and the sandbox at demo.ramp.com. The open-source CLI is only a client to the hosted service, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
